operations.label: Prepare the lead precursor mixture
operations.description: Dissolve 1.5 g lead acetate and 5.1 mL oleic acid in 25 mL phenyl ether. Lead-acetate hydration is unspecified.

operations.label: Heat the lead mixture under flowing nitrogen

environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Heat to 140 °C for 1 h with stirring and continuous nitrogen flow.

operations.label: Cool below 70 °C

temperature.qualifier: Strictly below 70 °C, not an exact 70 °C target.

operations.description: Cool the precursor solution below 70 °C before adding the TOPSe stock; cooling rate is unreported.

operations.label: Add 12 mL of 1 M TOPSe solution
operations.description: Add 12 mL of the reported 1 M TOPSe stock to form the molecular precursor solution. No stock-preparation method or stock solvent is supplied.

operations.label: Rapidly inject into hot phenyl ether

temperature.qualifier: Common injection-temperature range; larger particles use higher temperatures but individual size-to-setpoint assignments are not supplied.

environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Load the molecular precursor into a 50 mL syringe and rapidly inject into a flask containing 40 mL vigorously stirred phenyl ether under continuous nitrogen flow. Injection temperature varies within 80–150 °C; exact volume and rate are not quantified.

operations.label: Grow the PbSe quantum dots

temperature.qualifier: Study-wide growth range, not a specific setting for each reported size.

duration.qualifier: Study-wide growth duration range, not a specific hold for each product context.

operations.description: Maintain at the selected growth temperature for 5–10 min. The growth temperature is varied within 80–150 °C. Per-size temperature/time assignments are not reported.

operations.label: Store in hexane
operations.description: Store the cooled colloid in hexane. Storage time, temperature, volume and concentration are not specified.

operations.label: Precipitate from hexane
operations.description: Precipitate PbSe dots from hexane using a butanol/methanol mixture. Butanol isomer, solvent ratio and volumes are not reported.

missing_fields: Complete supplied four-page main only; any SI and all 28 cited full sources remain unreviewed. Reference 28 is a source note about later theory, not independently checked here.

The common injection/growth range is 80–150 °C for 5–10 min, producing a continuous 3–8 nm series. Exact temperatures, times and physical batches are not assigned to the named 3, approximately 7 and approximately 8 nm outcomes.
Lead acetate hydration and reagent purities are unspecified. TOPSe is a 1 M solution, but its preparation and solvent are not supplied. Do not copy another article’s stock formulation.
The precursor is loaded into a 50 mL syringe; this is equipment capacity, not a measured injected volume. Injection rate and final precursor volume are unreported.

Storage hexane amount/time, butanol isomer, precipitation solvent ratio/volumes and centrifugation settings are not reported. The wording says the procedure was repeated twice; no normalized total-cycle count is invented.

The source reports rock-salt structure with the bulk lattice constant, but supplies no numeric lattice parameter, coordinates, refinement or exact sample assignment for Figure 1. Its lead-oleate impurity peaks remain explicit.

Figure 3 curves have no individual numeric size labels beyond the 3–8 nm series. Figure 5 contains three optical samples without sizes or per-curve quantum yields; no guessed size/recipe mapping or digitization is applied.

Lifetime 250 ns in Figure 6 is explicitly the 3 nm sample. The three separate Figure 5 lifetimes and uncertainties remain source context unless their sample mapping is explicit; no shared physical batch is inferred from coincident values.
Molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation refinements remain pending; unknown identities are not assigned unique atomistic structures.
